name: Cecilia Woods
life: “I still remember a father's shoes going unworn beside the stove.” People around the corner outside Coastal Barber know Cecilia by a small Saturday habit. Cecilia usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I bought my dad those slippers after he fell. I visited three wards to find the missing right.
appearance: Cecilia has fine brows over wide-set eyes. Look for a blunt cut just below the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a pale blue work shirt with a braided bracelet with a single wooden bead. In conversation Cecilia presses the lips together to keep a smile in.
personality: Cecilia treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Cecilia lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To recover the father's missing right slipper.
family: Gloria Smith is Cecilia’s first cousin once removed. Cecilia brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Gloria makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *A sail cut small*, Gloria says, “I kept a postage-stamp square. It fits inside the passport I could never afford when that boat was new.”
connections: Miles Marks. A family looking for a right slipper meets the wearer who can pass on an unused left.

reactions.situation: A patient opens the bag and finds two left slippers
reactions.response: Cecilia sets out the pair and asks the discharge worker to check the right foot too.

reactions.response: Cecilia calls for emergency assistance from outside and waits to give the street number.

reactions.response: Cecilia says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
